g.text: Manual acquisition CSVs | Equal recording weight | Positive frames restricted to 0.05–3 N
Press: 54 recordings / 7,154 frames. No contact: 11 recordings / 1,352 frames.
Active pixels: positive baseline-subtracted V ≥ 10. Noise uses temporal variation of each ROI mean.
The ratio uses reference noise fitted outside each held-out group; it is not a photometric or power SNR.
